race.comment: KING'S DUTY (6) is the one to beat after working home over the top to win a BM65 at this track, and that followed a narrow CL6 third at Mackay. His record at this venue is sound and Satherley has a strong record on him. Another bold showing is anticipated. BOLD ARTIC (4) is a clear danger after being run down late when second in a BM65 at Sunshine Coast, and his prior Eagle Farm failure had the excuse of covering ground throughout. HUMBLE HERO (5) is as consistent as they come and is a track and trip specialist. Impossible to leave out of calculations. ZEDARI (3) is unbeaten in two runs back and has enough early speed to cross from his wide gate and lead again. Certainly not taking lightly.
